Title: Aditya's Day

Cast

1. Aditya - 12 years, son
Look: red T-shirt, jeans
2. Meenakshi - 37 years, mother
Look: green saree

Places

1. The bedroom - a big bed, a wooden cupboard

Scene 1: The bedroom - Day

[Aditya stands in the bedroom. Meenakshi stands near him.]

Aditya: "Today feels like a good day."

[Aditya goes to bed and falls asleep.]

Meenakshi: "I knew it!"

[Aditya sits on the edge of the bed.]

Aditya: "I really enjoyed today."
